GET /vault.privacy: All vault routes require device authentication, a non-browser request, and a private transport. Responses are no-store; vault content never joins chat, search, events, or ordinary client caches.

GET /vault/items.authentication: Paired device and encrypted transport required. Returns names, origins, field names, and revisions only; no values or unlock session.

PUT /vault/items/{id}.concurrency: Client-generated IDs and revisions prevent lost updates; revision 0 creates.

GET /vault/items/{id}.authentication: Returns metadata and blank replacement fields only; saved values never leave the server.

POST /vault/cards/{id}/save.description: Private card edit: saves encrypted fields and a value-free completion in one transaction; requires device pairing.

POST /vault/import.description: Private Settings import. Requires device pairing. Accepts CSV or JSON up to 8 MiB, or multipart KDBX up to 32 MiB with password and optional keyfile up to 1 MiB. Never accepts server paths or creates chat cards; imports atomically and skips duplicates.

POST /vault/cards/{id}/import.description: Private CSV or JSON upload, raw body up to 8 MiB; never an ordinary chat attachment. Requires device pairing; stores only encrypted entries and completion metadata.

PUT /vault/browser.authentication: Only an explicit loopback Chromium CDP endpoint is accepted.

query.limit: page size, default 100, maximum 1000; keep fetching after last received seq until an empty page

GET /threads/{id}/events.order: ascending seq; event cursors are scoped to a conversation

GET /threads/{id}/stream.response: text/event-stream; each data field is one Event JSON; replay before live delivery

POST /threads/{id}/messages.idempotency: SendRequest.id is the client message identity; retries return the original accepted message without another agent turn

POST /threads/{id}/voice.privacy: Private agent consultation, never accepted into typed chat or indexed. Only explicit send_to_user/show_html publications become messages.
POST /threads/{id}/voice.cancellation: Request disconnect cancels only this private task. No automatic replay; duplicate IDs are refused for the server lifetime.

DELETE /agents/{id}.idempotency: Deleting an already deleted identity returns deleted=true without recreating it.

DELETE /threads/{id}.note: Delete a group chat and its messages while preserving its member bots. Direct bot chats return 409; missing chats return 404.

POST /threads/{id}/messages/{messageID}/.note: save a question answer and queue a turn for its author atomically

GET /plugins.description: Installed plugins and the shared layout: the switcher order, which always holds chats, and the ordered groups of Scoped buttons. A group of two or more is merged.

GET /plugins/market.description: The configured plugin index, read by the server. The last good copy is served when it can't be reached.

POST /plugins.description: Downloads a listed version in the background, verifies its SHA-256, and takes its kind from the package rather than the index.

PATCH /plugins/{name}.description: Replaces the chats a Scoped plugin is active in.

DELETE /plugins/{name}.description: Stops a plugin and removes its files and data.

PUT /plugins/layout.description: Saves the shared layout. The response is normalised against installed plugins.

ANY /plugins/{name}/api/{path...}.description: Forwards an authenticated request to the plugin's own service. Answers 503 while that service isn't running.

ANY /plugins/hub/api/{path...}.description: The Hub plugin's API: status, chats, sync, media, logins, links, broadcasts and mail. Its types are the Hub definitions here; docs/plugins.md lists the routes.

query.limit: Newest runs and deliveries to return, each at most 200.

GET /work.authentication: Paired device required. Tool output is left out.
